responsibility: This header declares the Fortran preprocessor interface layered over libcpp. It provides entry points for enabling and configuring preprocessing, handling options, include paths and dependencies, running preprocessing on a source file, querying preprocessing-only and makedep modes, and initializing and shutting down the cpp subsystem used by scanner and option handling.
same_name_distinction: Declares the Fortran preprocessor control surface—initialization, option handling, include-path management, dependency hooks, and preprocess invocation. Unlike gcc/fortran/cpp.cc, it is the interface header, not the libcpp callback and processing implementation.
